rationale: The prediction overwhelmingly favored a period because an existing high-weight period rule matches after any noun; the gradient nudged ended upward but left it very unlikely. Add a targeted continuation for a prefix ending in “story,” supporting the common narrative construction “the story ended” without suppressing other valid noun-final continuations globally. This may overfavor ended when story is followed by a different predicate or punctuation, so the replay gate should assess the tradeoff; this proposal has not passed that gate.
